artifact.note: The artifact is the model card the platform publishes and is checksum-addressed. This completion document is stored beside it and never inside it, so every previously published hash remains valid.

identity.name: Mizuna edible-leaf microbial load, within-campaign relative (VEG-04A/B)
identity.task: Within-campaign relative culturable aerobic microbial load on edible leaf tissue

purpose: Predict the microbial load of mizuna leaf tissue relative to its own campaign mean, in within-campaign standard deviations of log10 CFU per gram.
intendedUse: Comparing flight and ground harvests of the same experiment on a relative scale, where the question is whether a treatment raised or lowered load rather than what the absolute load was.
notIntendedFor: Absolute microbial load. The absolute model is retained but withdrawn from service because it does not transfer to an unseen campaign (R2 -0.55 and -0.58).
Safety or consumability decisions. The endpoint is culturable aerobic count on leaf tissue, not pathogen presence.
Crops other than mizuna, or campaigns other than VEG-04.

features.name: logFreshWeightG
features.unit: log10 of fresh mass in grams

trainingData.hashBasis: SHA-256 of data/processed/mizuna_microbial_load.csv exactly as committed. Covers 123 leaf-tissue measurements across 35 biological groups; the table is produced from the committed OSD-780 records by scripts/preprocess_osd780.py.
trainingData.reconstruction: python3 scripts/preprocess_osd780.py rebuilds the table from the committed raw records.

supportingInputs.role: NASA OSDR source records, committed under data/raw/OSD-780

split.method: Leave-one-campaign-out transfer, with group-level cross-conformal calibration.
split.note: The transfer set is a whole campaign, not a held-out row set; that is why the absolute-load predecessor failed and this relative successor is served.

uncertainty.statement: Group-level cross-conformal interval, radius 1.679 in within-campaign standard deviations, nominal 90 % coverage, achieved 0.9919 over 35 calibration groups. The exchangeability unit is the biological group.
uncertainty.artifactKind: 90% group-level cross-conformal interval, measured held-out coverage 0.992

limitations: Predicts RELATIVE load within a campaign. It cannot predict an absolute level for a new campaign without that campaign's own baseline samples.
Plate counts capture only culturable aerobic organisms; total microbial load is higher and unmeasured.
The target is microbial load on leaf tissue, not biomass, yield, growth rate or shelf life.
logFreshWeightG is the mass of the assay subsample, not harvest biomass.
Two campaigns only, both VEG-04 mizuna on ISS. No lettuce, tomato or radish transfer.
Flight/ground differences may reflect cabin environment, payload handling or sampling protocol rather than gravity. Causality is not established.
Not a food-safety clearance tool. Do not use for consumption decisions.

outOfDomainBehaviour.mechanism: The artifact's `domain` block is enforced before scoring; a request outside it is refused with the field and range named rather than extrapolated, and a transcriptomic model rejects a partial expression vector instead of zero-filling.
